source: FMScouter player archetypes (Game Icons via Iconify; CC BY 3.0)

archetypes.label: Shot Stopper
archetypes.description: Prevents goals above expected and keeps the concession rate low.

archetypes.label: Sweeper Keeper
archetypes.description: Plays out confidently with progressive passing and low possession loss.

archetypes.label: Distributor
archetypes.description: High passing volume that regularly advances the ball upfield.

archetypes.label: Ball Winner
archetypes.description: Wins possession through tackles, interceptions, and recoveries.

archetypes.label: Aerial Threat
archetypes.description: Contests and wins a high share of aerial duels.

archetypes.label: Presser
archetypes.description: Applies intense pressing pressure to force turnovers high up the pitch.
archetypes.note: Uses pressures when present in the active threshold pack for the group; otherwise possession_won + tackles_attempted.

archetypes.label: Safe Carrier
archetypes.description: Carries or dribbles often while keeping possession losses low.

archetypes.label: Progressive Passer
archetypes.description: Moves the team forward with frequent progressive passes.

archetypes.label: Playmaker
archetypes.description: Creates chances with key passes, xA, and progressive distribution.

archetypes.label: Dribbler
archetypes.description: Beats opponents regularly with a high dribble rate.

archetypes.label: Goalscorer
archetypes.description: Produces goals and shots at a strong expected-goals volume.

archetypes.label: Creator
archetypes.description: Sets up teammates with assists, xA, and key passes.

archetypes.label: Box Threat
archetypes.description: A defender who arrives in the box to shoot and score.
